name: Ember
description: An evening restaurant and wine bar seen by candlelight: a warm light that follows the pointer over the dark room, the name at poster size, an evening that runs from the first pour to the last glass as you scroll, a tilted cream menu card, a cellar page and private dining.

questions.question: How do guests book a table?

options.label: Online, with the form
options.description: The reservation form stays; requests arrive in Upstart's Content tab.

options.label: By phone
options.description: A call button and the number in place of the form.

options.label: Walk-ins only
options.description: The booking buttons and form go; the visit page says how it works.

options.label: Both
options.description: The private dining page with its rooms, and the events, each with its page.

options.label: Neither
options.description: Both go; the menu, the cellar and the visit page stay.
